original.statement: Support for Telemetry customization in the waypoint proxy was added.

decision.reason: [ev-437e36865221] only says the waypoint proxy now supports `Telemetry` customization. In other words, waypoints now honour an existing resource kind. It does not say a Telemetry group/version/kind is newly served, so "gvk added" misreads the note. The evidence also names no API version: P1 says v1alpha1 and P2 says v1, and nothing settles which is right. No subject family fits a "waypoint now honours Telemetry" capability cleanly, so I can't build a reliable correction from this evidence alone.
